sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer.

We are ready to give you the firm commitment you asked for: a binding 23,400 pieces per year for 24 months, and we accept the longer lead time of 56 days so you can plan production.

Our orders for the 24 mm mechanical seal were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for this seal is EUR 24.31 per piece (cost:340010).

At our annual review in March your key account manager explained that price changes above 2% need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260310-70410-M1). We therefore propose a change you can confirm yourself, without the committee: +2.0% on today's price, EUR 30.48 per piece.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the proposed volume of 23,400 pieces and the 24-month contract duration. 

While your historical price references are noted, current operational parameters require an adjustment. We offer €31.50 per unit for this package, with a Lieferzeit of 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your answer. We move towards you: we extend the commitment to 36 months, 70,200 pieces in total.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).
Producer prices DE: other rubber products changed -0.3% from 2026-01 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-C2219@2026-01, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-02).

We know a step of this size goes to your pricing committee. Please put EUR 30.60 per piece for the 36 months to the committee; we are glad to wait for its decision.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have verified the index data you provided; its overall impact is marginal. We acknowledge the proposed extension to a 36-month contract duration. In return for this longer commitment, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.40 per unit.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Ourangebot consists of a price of €31.40 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
